{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
valid_sales = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate difference within each segment
stratified_rates = valid_sales.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search) within each segment
diff_by_segment = stratified_rates['email'] - stratified_rates['paid_search']

# Compute overall difference using direct standardisation (weighted by segment size)
# First, compute overall conversion rates by segment and channel
segment_sizes = valid_sales['customer_segment'].value_counts()
total_emails = valid_sales[valid_sales['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
total_paid_search = valid_sales[valid_sales['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]

# Weighted average of segment-specific differences
weighted_diff = (diff_by_segment * segment_sizes).sum() / (segment_sizes.sum())

# Return results
diff_by_segment, weighted_diff"}
